notes.title: Rotoscape Demo Update V3.4.7b
notes.content:
Rotoscape Demo Update V3.4.7b

CHANGELOG:
Added:
- New Anti-Aliasing option, can help with performance
- Game now pauses when you open the Discord Overlay
- Game now pauses when you open the Steam Overlay

Changes:
- Removed shape that appears on transition in Heptascape
- Shapes now show up faster as they increase in speed
- Adjusted coin collection sound to be quieter

Bug Fixes:
- Capped framerate to monitor refresh rate when V-Sync is not enabled

Attempted bug fix:
- Potential fix for random lag spike when the day to night transition occurs in the game

notes.title: Rotoscape Demo Update V3.4.4b
notes.content:
Rotoscape Demo Update V3.4.4b

CHANGELOG:
Added:
- Added Academy (Practice mode) mode back into the game (it replaces the Arcade button in the Demo)
- Added speed modifier for Academy (you can now adjust the speed of shapes)
- Added Octagons to Academy

Changes:
- Modified T Square shape to be a little easier
- Modified difficulty curve to be less sudden

Bug Fixes:
- Fixed tabbing out of the game during the Game Over screen
- Fixed the music progress bar not filling up all the time
- Fixed Donut

notes.title: Rotoscape Demo Update V3.4.2b
notes.content:
Rotoscape Demo Update V3.4.2b

CHANGELOG:
```
Added: 
- Speeds are now capped after 120 m/s, meaning after you reach 120 m/s, the speed will only be incremented by 10
- All levels now have a maximum speed cap, Octagon's being lower so that you can actually see the shapes
- The game will now automatically pause on losing focus (the music too)

Changes:
- Lines are more visible in Octagon
- Removed the delay after shapes exit the player's border
- Changed how the shape leaves once it fades out

Removed:
- Play audio in background option has been removed because audio advancing causes issues with the rhythmic timing of the game.

Bug Fixes:
- Fixed some score issue
- Fixed pause menu timer

```

notes.title: Rotoscape Demo Update V3.4.1b
notes.content:
Rotoscape Demo Update V3.4.1b

CHANGELOG:
Changes:
- The line guides showing where the shape is coming from in Night Mode have been brought back
- The Square T shape no longer spawns after a certain speed
- There is now a .25 second delay after leaving a shape before it fades out
    - Keep in mind that means you need to prevent yourself from touching the outside again

Bug Fixes:
- MAJOR: Fixed physics bug where objects could occasionally pass through player at high speeds
- Fixed pause menu issue when spamming it
- Fixed Triborg Phase 3 taking damage occasionally when pausing
- Fixed Triborg Phase 2 where damage wouldn't be taken
- Fixed parallax in Level Select Menu

Potential bug fix:
- Attempted fix for Player busted invincibility timer that happens occasionally

notes.title: Rotoscape Demo Update V3.4.0b
notes.content:
Rotoscape Demo Update V3.4.0b

This is a big quality of life update, we hope you enjoy it while we push onwards to the final release date!

Speaking of which, our release date is slated for April 12th, 2021! ːsteamthumbsupː

Important:

The leaderboards are being reset this update.
Also, the demo's leaderboards and final game's leaderboards will be **separate**.

CHANGELOG: 
Added:
- The inside of shapes no longer kills you. Instead, you get pushed around. If you get pushed too far, you take damage.
- New shapes have been added
- Donut shape is back in the shop
- Heptascape has been changed significantly (still temporary, final level will look very different)
- Added controller glyphs
- Added remappable controls
- Added full controller support
- Added tutorial in menu
- Added "Fullscreen Exclusive" mode to the options menu
- Added more VSync options (use this instead of the framerate limiter)
- Mouse cursor dot is now animated
- Added toggleable mouse cursor border
- Gameplay UI is now animated
- Gameplay UI is now colored
- VSync input lag significantly reduced
- Reintroduced Shape Queue
- More optimizations

Changed:
- Mouse Sensitivity has been adjusted
- Updated the colors of all the levels for higher contrast
- Moved Shot Count indicator to bottom right where it is easier to see
- Difficulty curve increases much faster than before, but starts slower
- Fragments are now obtained by shooting "static" shapes
- Adjusted Octagon glow rate
- Moved delete save option to first menu
- Increased color contrast of player and mouse cursor dot
- Updated Triangle Night level background
- Updated credits & credits music
- Fixed Triborg & cutscenes, AGAIN
- Updated Triborg end cutscene
- Joystick deadzone has been moved to Joystick calibration in the Rebind Controls option

Removed:
- Removed shape indicator lines from night mode
- Removed framerate limiter (Unity no longer recommends this)

Bug Fixes:
- Player no longer dies from getting hit by shapes in cutscenes
- Menu animation glitches have been fixed
- Fixed enormous lag spikes caused by Shape Queue
- Boss score is no longer tweetable
- Fixed musical timing issues
- Fixed Shop Menu glitch where wrong character would be selected
- Fixed bug with certain shape's hitboxes being invalid
- Many other bug fixes (see Trello)
